hero_headline: The Perfect Venue For All Your **Holiday Celebrations**
hero_subhead: Corporate parties and private celebrations, under a heritage roof in Uptown Waterloo. One all-inclusive package covers the room, the bar, the food and the staff — so on the night, you get to be a guest at your own party.
hero_proof_quote: “The vibes were off the charts. The space is so beautifully done.”
incl_subhead: Everything you need for a memorable celebration, handled by our dedicated events team.
cta_subhead: Tell us your date and your headcount. We'll come back with a package built around your group — or book a tour first and walk the rooms yourself.
gallery_headline: What Your Party Actually Looks Like
gallery_subhead: Real holiday nights in the building. The bar open, the rooms low-lit, the staircase full.
testi_intro: Three groups who booked the building for a party, in their own words. Verbatim from Google, trimmed only for length.
testi_1_quote: “Paige, Hannah, Alysha, and Cassie facilitated a fantastic retirement party for a dear colleague and friend. The facility at Den 1880 was perfect and as the night evolved, we migrated through the rooms from cocktails to dessert… Details matter and Den 1880 outperformed in every way.”
testi_2_quote: “Delta Phi Nu recently hosted our annual Blue Diamond Banquet in March… There was gorgeous furniture, coloured lighting and unique architecture. We fell in love instantly… On the big day, Paige and her team were so attentive and helpful for set-up, during the banquet and clean-up.”
testi_3_quote: “Incredible space & team! Every detail is thoughtfully curated, I took a million pictures. Amazing place to host or attend an event in a space that wows. Went to the Vines & Wines night — the people and experience were 10/10.”
